profiles.name: Elsevier (general artwork)
notes: Publisher-general guidance; the exact journal Guide for Authors overrides it.
7 pt normal text / 6 pt subscript and superscript is a rule of thumb, not an absolute prohibition; minFontPt uses the normal-text planning floor.
RGB is preferred, not a universal prohibition on other colour spaces. Office files are also accepted; this profile lists image export formats only.

AI explanatory illustrations require caption and general AI-statement disclosure. AI-assisted data figures must derive directly from data with reproducible methods and disclosure in Methods. AI-assisted code diagrams also need disclosure of the assistance; this does not classify them as AI-generated pictures. Manually authored code has no AI use to disclose.
image-edit is conservatively forbidden for primary observed/experimental images; exceptions for research methods require reproducible Methods reporting. The broad kind cannot distinguish these cases.
AI graphical abstracts are forbidden; AI cover art requires prior editor/publisher permission (cover use is not modelled by FigureKind).
maxHeightMm, CVD requirement and panelsInOneFile were not verified.

profiles.name: Copernicus (EGU journals)

colour.colourMapAdvice: Use CVD-readable colour schemes; Scientific colour maps 7.0 recommended; cite Crameri et al. (2020).

notes: 80 mm is a minimum figure width, not a fixed column width.
All figures should have 300 dpi; multi-panel figures are combined into one file. Fonts in figure compositions must be embedded.

AI illustration/schematic generation is permitted with tool name, purpose and extent in Methods or Acknowledgements; never hallucinate/unverifiable data. The data-figure rule records disclosure of generative AI assistance, not permission to invent observations.
No explicit graphical-abstract or AI image-edit rule was verified: those remain unknown.
Minimum font point size, maximum height and required colour mode were not specified in the opened pages.
For code-diagram, disclose applies when generative AI assisted diagram creation; manually authored code has no AI use to disclose. It is not an AI-picture classification.

profiles.name: AGU journals

sources.title: Using AI tools in your research

notes: AGU Text & Graphics Requirements (https://www.agu.org/publications/authors/journals/text-graphics-requirements) and Resources & FAQs (https://www.agu.org/Publications/Authors/Resources-FAQs) both returned HTTP 403 during direct curl on 2026-10-22. AGU-specific widths, font sizes, height, DPI, formats, colour, panel and per-kind AI rules remain unverified.

The readable Wiley publisher AI page requires disclosure of AI visual creation/editing and prohibits AI-edited research photographs. It is provided as related publisher guidance, not substituted for blocked AGU-specific policy; the per-kind verdicts stay unknown.
Historical AGU graphics guidance and general Wiley figure sizes are not confirmed as current AGU requirements and were not imported. Nulls and empty format lists mean unverified, not unrestricted.

profiles.name: Geosciences Journal (Springer artwork)

colour.colourMapAdvice: Use patterns in addition to colour so distinctions do not depend on colour alone.

notes: The actual Geosciences Journal page lists 84 / 174 mm and maximum 234 mm for large-format journals. It does not establish 39 / 129 mm; those values are not shipped. Confirm the journal layout before selecting the large-format width.
The same page separately lists 119 mm width / 195 mm height for small-format journals; these alternatives are not represented by this large-format profile.
The 8–12 pt lettering range is recommended (usually about 2–3 mm), not an absolute minimum. minFontPt is a planning floor.
EPS and TIFF are preferred; MSOffice files are also acceptable. Image export lists do not establish exhaustive format prohibitions.

AI policy link redirects to a risk framework: verifiable assistive use is allowed; unverifiable output/deepfakes are not. It does not settle each FigureKind, so all per-kind verdicts remain unknown; the journal page requires Methods documentation of LLM use.
CVD simulation requirement and panelsInOneFile were not verified.

profiles.name: GSA journals

colour.colourMapAdvice: Avoid rainbow maps; use distinguishable colours plus labels, patterns and differing line forms.

sources.title: Authorship and Artificial Intelligence Tools Policy

notes: Journal widths use the table centimetre values: 59 / 122.8 / 148.2 mm. The full-width row says 7.125 inches and 18.5 cm, which disagree, so full width stays null. The page-height row also has inconsistent units; maxHeightMm stays null.
7–12 pt lettering; panel letters A/B/C should be 13–16 pt at final size. Photos 300–600 ppi; raster line art at least 1200 ppi. No separate combination floor was specified.

The profile lists publication-quality/native formats: after acceptance supply a native file plus EPS, TIFF or PDF. Initial submission instead allows PDF (preferred), TIFF, GIF and JPEG. CMYK/RGB and a mandatory CVD simulation were not specified; CVD-readable design and avoiding rainbow maps are explicit advice.

AI tools used to create text, images, tables or data analysis must be disclosed in a separate section, naming tools, use and affected portions. disclose records that obligation, not unconditional acceptance. Explicit AI image-edit and graphical-abstract permissions were not verified.

profiles.name: 대한지질학회지 / Journal of the Geological Society of Korea
notes: Figures must fit A4 paper and remain legible after reduction. No numerical final width, font point size, height or DPI was specified, so those fields remain null; an A4 paper size is not a figure-width requirement.
JPG is recommended, not an exhaustive allowed-format list. Captions must be in English. Colour mode, CVD simulation and panelsInOneFile were not specified.

AI use during research/manuscript preparation must disclose purpose, scope and method in Main Text, Methods or Acknowledgements; human authors remain responsible for AI text, images and analysis. disclose records that obligation, not unconditional acceptance of every generated image. Explicit image-edit or graphical-abstract permission was not verified.

profiles.name: 자원환경지질 / Economic and Environmental Geology
notes: Direct curl on 2026-10-22 returned an empty reply (curl exit 52) for all identified official pages: https://www.kseeg.org/content/authors/guide_for_authors.html ; https://www.kseeg.org/content/authors/publication_ethics.html ; https://www.kseeg.or.kr/content/journal/editor_rule.php .
